text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to extend the existing "School Bus Loading Zone" on the north side of Plains Road, west of Woodbine Avenue. The proposed extension will allow an additional parking space for a school bus to drop-off and pick-up students to Canadian Martyrs Catholic School.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Amended the existing school bus loading zone in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., on the north side of Plains Road, between a point 38 metres east of Woodmount Avenue and a point 77.5 metres east of Woodmount Avenue, to be in effect from a point 63 metres east of Woodmount Avenue to a point 115 metres further east. 2. Amended the existing stopping prohibition in effect from 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the north side of Plains Road, between Woodmount Avenue and Woodbine Avenue, to be in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the north side of Plains Road, between Woodmount Avenue and Woodbine Avenue.
